title: Demo Loop
user: Creative-technology students needing a credible 20–45 second proof-of-interaction for a portfolio, even when their prototype is fragile.
smallest_useful_product: Browser recorder that captures a selected tab plus optional mic, lets the maker mark one interaction beat and one caption, and exports a short WebM and poster image.
success_measure: 60% of recordings are exported without opening another editor.
constraints: Use screen-capture permission only on explicit action; keep media local; browser codec fallbacks; never claim archival quality.
why_distinct: It is tuned to showing an interaction's cause and effect, not a generic screencast service.
